blocks.text: Latest update 10:17 p.m. MAKATI CITY, Philippines — An earthquake with a magnitude estimated at 5.8 has struck southern Philippines around 9:41 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. According to an advisory from the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology, the temblor had a depth of 10 km and was located off General Luna in Surigao del Norte. The shaking was felt all the way in Eastern Visayas, at Intensity 3 in the town of Abuyog, Leyte. It was likewise felt at the same intensity in the municipalities of Sogod and San Francisco in Southern Leyte. The quake registered Intensity 2 in Dulag […]...
